name: Linn boogie down
desc: AkaiLinn 80s boogie: kick on 1 and the and-of-3, layered snare+clap on 2&4, late-patterned swung 8th hats, uzu shaker 16ths that breathe out every 8th cycle, rotating cowbell euclid. Peak flips the kick to four-floor with snare-roll phrase fills.

gain.doc: kick level, other layers scale from it

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}).shape(.18), s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [sd,cp]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.6).room(${snroom}), s("hh*8").bank("AkaiLinn").gain("[.42 .2]*4").late("[0 .022]*4").lpf(sine.range(3000, ${hcut}).slow(16)).pan(sine.range(.42, .58).slow(11)), s("sh*16").gain("[.2 .08 .14 .06]*4").pan(cosine.range(.55, .68).slow(16)).mask("<1 1 1 1 1 1 1 0>"), s("cb(2,8,<0 4>)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(.22).pan(.35).every(8, x=>x.fast(2))).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}).shape(.2), s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [sd,cp]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.65).room(${snroom}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("hh*8").bank("AkaiLinn").gain("[.48 .24]*4").late("[0 .02]*4").ply("<1 1 1 2>").lpf(sine.range(4000, ${hcut}).slow(8)), s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.45), s("sh*16").gain("[.24 .1 .17 .08]*4").pan(cosine.range(.55, .7).slow(12)), s("cb(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(.24).pan(.35)).orbit(1).play()
